title: 特斯拉的冰火时刻
content: Tesla has reached 10 million cumulative EV deliveries, with H1 2026 sales rebounding after two years of decline. However, profit margins are shrinking amid intense price competition, particularly in China, where the company may divest its operations to facilitate a potential SpaceX merger. Tesla is aggressively pivoting toward "physical AI," investing heavily in autonomous driving, Robotaxi services, and humanoid robots, with Optimus V3 production planned. Despite these growth narratives, Q2 2026 saw a 57% drop in operating profit and negative free cash flow, triggering a record $214.5 billion single-day market cap loss as investors weigh future potential against present financial strain.

title: 上海雪花膏，破产了
content: Shanghai Meilan Cosmetics, maker of the iconic "Shanghai Snow Cream" (雪花膏), has been declared bankrupt by a Shanghai court. Founded in 1984, the company once dominated China's budget skincare market with its classic white cream but failed to modernize its products, target younger consumers, or develop online sales channels. A disastrous 2021 acquisition by shady listed company Shenzhen Grandtone—later delisted for fraud and violence against regulators—accelerated its collapse. With just 95,000 yuan in assets against 19.4 million yuan in debts, the brand's failure illustrates how nostalgia-based business models with aging distribution channels cannot survive China's transformed cosmetics market.

title: 奥特曼承认：高估了AI抢饭碗！黄仁勋：失业论完全搞反了
content: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman revised his earlier prediction, acknowledging he overestimated AI's speed in eliminating entry-level white-collar jobs and that people don't want AI CEOs because accountability requires humans. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang argued that AI replacing tasks differs from eliminating jobs entirely, citing growing software engineering and radiology positions. Research from 155 million U.S. job postings shows no economy-wide hiring collapse, with entry-level positions actually increasing. However, AI is absorbing standardized starter tasks that traditionally developed junior workers' skills, narrowing career entry pathways while shifting human work value toward responsibility, trust-building, and decision ownership.

title: AI来了，大厂中层不好混了
content: AI is disrupting middle management at major tech companies. ByteDance, Tencent, and JD.com have flattened hierarchies and reduced management layers; Amazon's recent cuts targeted 78% of L5-L7 roles. Five managers interviewed describe increased workloads, pressure to demonstrate AI-driven efficiency metrics, and eroding job security. AI automates task distribution, progress tracking, and information relay—traditional middle-manager functions. Those who resist AI risk obsolescence; those who adapt gain opportunities. The role shifts from resource coordination to hands-on technical judgment, error verification, and orchestrating human-AI teams. Managerial value now requires proving daily relevance rather than relying on tenure or hierarchy.

title: 如何将你对学习的热爱转化为一人公司
content: People who love learning and have broad interests possess a natural advantage in the creator economy. Modern digital tools—code, media, and AI—provide unprecedented leverage for individuals to build audience and monetize knowledge without traditional gatekeepers. The core business model: deeply study your interests, package insights into compelling content, and develop systematic products that help others achieve transformations you've experienced. Your brand emerges from helping people move from their current state to a desired one, even if you're on the journey too. Content acts as a map guiding this progression; products become execution tools. Success requires mastering attention mechanisms, developing your unique voice, and treating research as essential work.

Apple reported record Q2 2026 results with $109.4B revenue (up 16.4%) and $29.8B net profit (up 27%), marking its best second quarter ever. All products and regions grew double-digits, led by iPhone (21.7% growth) and Mac (28.7%). Yet the stock fell 8% after-hours as investors favored pure-AI plays like Microsoft and AMD.

Apple's AI efforts lagged: Siri upgrades repeatedly delayed, forcing partnerships with Google for U.S. models and Alibaba/Baidu for China, where AI regulatory approval finally came in July. title: Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed
content: GitHub optimized case folding for its code search engine, which processes over 480TB of source code. The key insight was removing an early-exit optimization: scanning the entire buffer branchlessly proved faster than stopping at the first non-ASCII byte. This enabled LLVM vectorization, achieving over 45 GiB/s on ASCII text—15× faster than naive approaches. For Unicode, they devised a compact 1776-byte structure using page bitmaps and run-length encoding that performs folds via byte-space arithmetic without decoding UTF-8. The open-source Rust crate, "casefold," avoids heap allocation when possible and handles edge cases like length-changing folds efficiently.
